answer_1.quote: For summarization, we use the test portions of Extreme Summarization (Xsum) and CNN/Daily Mail (CNN/DM) to evaluate the quality of summaries generated by language models with ROUGE-1.

answer_2.quote: For ASR, we measure word error rates (WERs) on the test portions of three English datasets: CommonVoice 16 (CV16), LibriSpeech, and TED-LIUM. For summarization, we use the test portions of Extreme Summarization (Xsum) and CNN/Daily Mail (CNN/DM) to evaluate the quality of summaries generated by language models with ROUGE-1.
